run_info_cli: run the typer CLI info command to print aggregated LLVM autotuning experiment results from log directories
run_experiments_from_paths: run experiments_from_paths to load Experiment objects from a list of log directory paths
run_info_all_runs: run the info command with all_runs flag to print per-experiment benchmark tables in grid format
run_info_nonzero_reward: run the info command with only_nonzero_reward to exclude zero-reward runs from experiment analysis
run_info_group_by_dir: run the info command with group_by_working_directory to aggregate results by working directory
